title: Stay Here Beside Me
style: Soft-rock power ballad, intimate piano opening with restrained clean electric guitar and warm bass, steady live drums entering gradually, soaring but controlled chorus with broad electric-guitar sustain and subtle string pads. Male and female duet trading reflective verses, then close harmonies in the chorus; conversational phrasing, emotional restraint building into a heartfelt climax, polished organic studio mix.
lyrics:
[Verse 1: Male]
You said the word, it settled on the table
A small new name with weight I couldn't place
For years we let the question stay unfinished
Now every answer seems to take up space

[Verse 2: Female]
I watched the room speak softly through its glances
You caught the parts that no one said aloud
We changed the subject, laughed about the evening
While something tender moved beneath the crowd

[Pre-Chorus: Male]
I thought the secret made the edges safer
A room where I could simply just be me
But all the plans made kindly in the distance
Still leave me wishing you would ask, not see

[Chorus: Duet]
Stay here beside me, don't make me decide
What every feeling means tonight
No grand confession, no promise to keep
Just your arms around me while I fall asleep
If morning brings a different heart, that's all right
Stay here beside me tonight

[Verse 3: Female]
You told me how the hidden felt like shelter
One quiet place where you could drop the act
And how the eyes around us might crowd in
Till work and wanting tangled into fact

[Verse 4: Male]
I know the love behind their careful planning
I know they think they're helping us be free
But even good intentions leave me wondering
If anyone has asked what I might need

[Pre-Chorus: Female]
You don't have to name the shape you're feeling
You don't owe the morning certainty
I'll leave the door unlocked for any answer
And let tonight be only what it is

[Chorus: Duet]
Stay here beside me, don't make me decide
What every feeling means tonight
No grand confession, no promise to keep
Just your arms around me while I fall asleep
If morning brings a different heart, that's all right
Stay here beside me tonight

[Bridge: Duet]
No map across the room, no watching eyes
No need to turn this moment into proof
Your hand can rest exactly where it lands
And I can choose the quiet here with you

[Final Chorus: Duet]
Stay here beside me, we don't have to decide
What every feeling means tonight
No grand confession, no promise to keep
Just your arms around me while I fall asleep
If morning brings a different heart, that's all right
Stay here beside me tonight
Stay here beside me tonight

[Outro: Female]
Let the morning come when it comes
[Male]
For now, just stay
